'''Choah Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it was rumored that the long-dead [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Shisha Mor]] had used one of the asteroids as a hideout. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained a [[Choah Belt fuel refinery/Legends|fuel refinery]] in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field until shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered its location and destroyed it, forcing the Alliance to try and [[Battle for Black Ice|hijack]] the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''.
